TechnologyApplicationsServicesAbout SynboliLet’s talk

AI and chemistry
for polymer discovery.

Synboli combines artificial intelligence and patented chemistry to accelerate the development of high-performance materials.

New polymer
structures.

A polymer’s structure shapes how it performs. Synboli brings together AI-guided discovery and patented synthesis to explore new structures for the properties an application requires.

Prediction narrows the search. Physical samples make it possible to evaluate what those structures can do. The two work together through successive development cycles.

Computational discovery

Application-specific databases combine proprietary synthesis data with trusted third-party sources. Specialised models predict polymer properties and guide candidate selection around your requirements.

Patented polymer synthesis

Proprietary chemistry accelerates sample production and testing while giving access to new structures. Laboratory and client evaluation provide the experimental information for the next iteration.

From data
to production.

High-quality data

High-quality databases bring together data generated through Synboli’s chemistry and trusted external sources, with a focus on the application being developed.

AI discovery

Specialised models predict properties and identify promising candidates. Development begins with structures selected around the material’s required performance.

Sample production

Synboli produces laboratory samples for testing and client validation. Results help refine the models and guide further synthesis.

Industrial scale-up

Specialist partners support the transition from laboratory candidates to industrial trials and commercial production.

Testing informs the next prediction and synthesis cycle.

Flexible development
solutions.

A focused sample project, an iterative development programme or a wider application exploration can use the same combination of data, prediction and experimental chemistry.
